scenario.name: Okanagan Valley — smoke reported west of the lake
scenario.groundTruthNote: Ignition point used to author this scenario. Known only to the demo, never to the pipeline — it exists so the UI can report how far off the computed fix landed.

calls.script: Yeah, hi, I'm down at the waterfront in Kelowna. There's a huge column of smoke going up across the lake, west of us, maybe west northwest? It's grey and it's really climbing. I can't tell how far, it's all the way across the water. Somebody needs to look at this.
